q1_issues.issue: "knew OF the girl" is encoded exactly like the plain "knew him" of the second clause (Member know + Experiencer + Stimulus), erasing the of/no-of contrast the sentence turns on; a prepositional verb's object is supposed to take the preposition-named oblique rather than a direct-object role.

q2_gaps: privative / temporal modifiers in a compound kind ("former schoolmate") — the mandated genus (Inheritance former_schoolmate schoolmate) wrongly entails that a former schoolmate still is one, and no alternative route is offered
a psych/perception verb with a prepositional object ("know of X") — Stimulus vs the preposition-named oblique is undetermined, since the prepositional-verb rule names only Patient/Theme

a concessive clause hanging off a reported-speech matrix — the main-clause-first rule points the connective at the saying event rather than the contrasted proposition, and whether the subordinate clause belongs inside or outside the seal is unspecified

an episodic bare-plural subject ("Police said yesterday") — a bare plural is the generic signal, yet the clause is a specific past event; the group-witness reading used here is not covered by any rule
notes: Nested sealing (say over believe), the Mr. Cruz title-in-the-name-string convention, the "one of her former schoolmates" partitive and the neither-nor pair of strength-0 bundles with their definite referents projected are all handled per the instruction set. Duplicating the Though atom across the two neither-nor conjuncts follows from splitting that clause into two facts.
